text:
zoe: Heads up from CobaltCloud QA - their GA image failed our end-to-end smoke on a subset of NVIDIA hosts. Can we coordinate a quick compatibility handshake?
matt: what failed specifically?
zoe: runtime crashes on startup with 'undefined symbol: cublasLtMatmul' when libcublas from host is 12.1 and our runtime expects 12.2. Also a handful of AMD boxes show hip kernel oops.
arjun: that symbol is from cublasLt introduced in 12.2. If hosts ship 12.1 meta, the dynamic linker will break. Two fast fixes: (A) provide a runtime build compatible with 12.1, or (B) pin driver/cuda in the marketplace image and publish a compatibility matrix.
tara: Cobalt PM asked for minimal friction - they prefer a single GA image. Can we give a short-lived hotpatch AMI and a clear remediation path?
cobalt-pm: we can freeze GA for 36h if you need it.
marketplace-team: suggest we produce both: a hotpatch AMI (pinned) for GA and a compatibility artifact for SIs. That buys them time.
arjun: I'll own building a compat runtime wheel for cuda12.1 and a small smoke container.
matt: I'll build the hotpatch AMI with driver 535.86.05 + cuda 12.2 and kernel 5.15.78 and run our smoke harness.
zoe: could you add a manifest field in marketplace metadata? Example: 
```nvidia_driver: "535.86.05"
cuda_compat: "runtime-cuda-12.1-compatible || cuda-12.2"
kernel_tested: "5.15.78"
artifact_links: ["gs://cobalt-partner/bundles/patch-v1/"]
```
zoe: ignore the JSON formatting above, but include those fields in README.
arjun: for air-gapped SIs I will produce signed debs + checksums. Plan to upload to gs://cobalt-partner/bundles/compat/ by EOD.
matt: smoke steps for AMI (dropping here):
```
sudo modprobe nvidia
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv
python -c "import ctypes; ctypes.CDLL('libcublas.so').cublasLtMatmul"
./redwood-smoke --model embed-small --backend cuda --tokens 256 --concurrency 2
```
marketplace-team: upload perms granted temporarily to cobalt-partner/bundles/patch-v1/.
ops-bot: ticket CO-921 created: cobaltcloud-driver-compat. Linked CI runs: ci/11441.
tara: telemetry ask: can we tag startup events with driver_bundle=cobalt-patch and driver_mismatch=true so we can triage field incidents quickly?
arjun: yes will add 'driver_bundle' and 'detected_driver_version' to startup events.
zoe: also request ROCm sanity: Cobalt has AMD hosts in their pool. If ROCm init fails, runtime should emit a clear message with artifact link and not crash.
arjun: will implement a soft-guard: if nvml/rocminfo fails, return clear error and fallback to cpu-quantized path after N retries.
matt: timeline: AMI build + smoke by 09:00 PT tomorrow, compat runtime wheel + signed debs by 06:00 PT. Marketplace manifest update by 16:00 PT.
cobalt-pm: thanks - we'll hold GA until you confirm. If everything passes we'll plan joint announcement after 48h stability window.
tara: action list (short):
- matt: hotpatch AMI + smoke (due 4449000900)
- arjun: runtime-cuda12.1 wheel + signed debs + checksum (due 4449000600)
- zoe: update marketplace README + comms draft (due 4449001600)
- marketplace-team: upload perms & manifest stub (done)

zoe: if something goes sideways, escalate to vendor partners with kernel bisect + core dump artifact. Keep this channel as primary.
arjun: I'll attach build logs to ticket CO-921.
matt: dropping the quick deb upload script for SIs:
```
#!/bin/bash
set -e
f=redwood-driver-535.86.05.deb
sha256sum "$f" > checksums.txt
gsutil cp "$f" checksums.txt gs://cobalt-partner/bundles/compat/
```
marketplace-team: CobaltCloud ops responded: 'Holding GA. Appreciate the fast turnaround.'
zoe: thanks everyone — please react with :thumbsup: when you accept your tasks.
arjun: :thumbsup:
matt: :thumbsup:
tara: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: note: CO-921 updated with artifacts path on upload.
